Not Now, Aliens! is Coming to Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hello!Great news! Not Now, Aliens! will be part of Steam Next Fest! events.title: Not Now, Aliens! Demo is now available!
events.summary: We hope you have a great time playing and enjoy the game! If you encounter any bugs, unfinished features, or have ideas and feedback, please let us know in the discussions. We’ll be reading everything and fixing issues as quickly as possible.And this is just the beginning — more updates are coming soon! Thank you for playing Not Now, Aliens!
